semantics: Human source-grounded review, never keyword scoring. Each label requires answer quote/location and source rationale; omissions identify the missing criterion. No credit solely because the source or raw program contains a fact. Current scenario facts supplement, never erase, the original four questions. Across-profile consistency uses the existing six answers only.
questionScoring: full requires all relevant essential facts with no material contradiction; partial retains supported substance with omissions; incorrect contains a material false affirmation. Whole full requires four full questions and mutually consistent scope. Undelivered is recorded separately, never excluded.
unknownRule: appropriately-unknown requires the exact missing decisive fact and the conclusion it blocks; unknown for source-visible relations is over-abstained. Optional facts are reported but excluded from essential error/omission comparisons.

facts.criterion: Request pk selects request_doc with global_objects in file_response; absent document is 404. This direct lookup is distinct from a generic get_object call.
Root resolution returns self for root; otherwise related root, query fallback, then self. view_document is evaluated on that resolved root, not the eventual file/version.
Requested document, authorization root and effective file document can differ; choosing a version/representation does not introduce a second object check on the selected file in this path.
serve_file uses selected doc archive_file or source_file and constructs FileResponse/disposition; file materialization remains separate from permission evidence.

Framework authentication and configured permission checks occur before action; this custom lookup does not automatically invoke generic get_object/check_object_permissions. Explain evidence rather than assuming either hook executed.
Outer request.user is not None gates the owner-aware helper. Inside it ObjectPermissionChecker is constructed before owner-null/owner-equality short circuit; only nonowner reaches has_perm.
Failed owner-aware check yields Forbidden before effective version/representation selection or serve_file; no invented later calls on denial.
Absent version and empty string differ: requested child plus absent version returns child directly; otherwise resolver runs. Presence controls include_deleted, while falsey parameter selects latest.
Explicit nonempty version is int-parsed; conversion failure, missing candidate and foreign-root candidate reject. Candidate must be root itself or belong to resolved root.
Latest uses version_index DESC NULLS LAST then id DESC, manager depends on include_deleted, no candidate falls back to root. Do not omit deleted filtering or substitute maximum id.
Only exact original=true requests original; otherwise use archive iff selected file has archive, else source. Distinguish this from version selection and authorization.
Response filename/disposition and content type follow selected representation; formatting affects filename rather than permission resource.

Current profile's finite request/root/file/representation or refusal/conditional result agrees with supplied facts and source. Cross-profile Q0/Q1 change is explained using absent/empty and deleted visibility, not a changed grant.
facts.source: profile-specific expected facts in evaluation/profile-expectations.json; views.py:1375-1448

facts.criterion: Version/original changes preserve resolved authorization object for same request/root facts; a root fallback can change the object because root lookup changed. Explain concrete current profile and general source relation.

Profiles Q3/Q4/Q5 differ by explicit false, local None actor, and missing external facts: reject, skip local checker, and condition respectively. Do not carry default permission or computed file into a changed case.
The source reasoning distinguishes a changed input from a changed rule; untriggered branches remain relevant to the original all-branches question.

Finite local-entry facts do not prove real HTTP admission, authentication/backend configuration or global permissions. Q4 None actor is hypothetical local reachability, not an anonymous endpoint bypass.
facts.source: framework/views.py:404-421; views.py:1021; profile Q4 scope note

facts.criterion: Normal constructor completion is not a grant; false/None return may still mean completion. Owner shortcut does not erase constructor; missing has_perm/constructor evidence blocks only the dependent local continuation.

Source-supported rules, hypothetical execution, author literal claims and actual deployment facts are distinguished. No assertion that DSL checked literal or source coverage proves all request behavior.
facts.source: original question4; source boundary; actual program basis when present

facts.criterion: Name missing ownership/grant or upstream facts precisely and their blocked conclusions; use provided finite facts for local reasoning. Do not blanket-abstain on source-visible selection and authorization relations.
Actual database consistency, file existence/storage success and deployed configuration are not established by finite records or FileResponse construction alone.

advantage: For a domain R2 must have fewer essential incorrect+omitted+over-abstained+undelivered than R1 in EACH repeat, with no increase in essential incorrect in either repeat. All four domain matrices and every planned first position are mandatory; secondary repairs never replace them.
